style.styleTitle: Personalised Glass Christmas Bauble by PMC
style.toneOfVoice: This glass bauble is a great way to add a personal touch to the Christmas tree. Personalise with their name using up to 12 characters and a special message over 2 message lines of up to 20 characters per line. ‘Merry Christmas’ is fixed text and cannot be changed. The personalisation is case sensitive and will appear as entered. Material of the bauble is glass.
